novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism route rather than merely a new setting: it asks whether “reversing the training objective (gradient ascent / sign-flipped loss) ... should install the OPPOSITE trait” and predicts “roughly symmetric” transfer. The closest verified prior work is Cloud et al., “Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data” (2025), which establishes positive hidden-trait transfer, while “Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer” studies its carrier mechanism and fragility; searches for “inverse subliminal learning,” “sign-flipped subliminal learning,” “gradient ascent hidden trait transfer,” and “negative subliminal transfer” did not reveal an essentially equivalent proposal. The step from positive subliminal learning to optimization-sign reversal is a natural but non-routine extension requiring a new core relationship—whether the latent channel is sign-symmetric—so this is above a direct object transfer, but it does not introduce a general new paradigm or overturn an established consensus.
